attempt: One try at a task by one worker incarnation, bounded by a lease expiry and a hard deadline.
claim: The JSONB payload forge_coding_worker_api.claim returns for the next task, decoded into the Claim struct.
freeze: The bootstrap moment after which the registry's factories may be constructed; nothing is built before it.
incarnation: A worker process lifetime, identified by a uuid; claims are tied to it.
lease: A claimed attempt: the pair (attempt_id, attempt_token). Explicit value, never a Drop guard; it expires server-side on its own schedule.
outcome: The terminal state an attempt publishes: completed work awaiting review, failure, or needs-reconcile.
owner: The coding owner identity stamped on every transaction via set_config('forge.coding_owner', owner, true); it scopes what the session may see and do.
policy digest: The frozen work-policy digest a worker advertises; the server rejects claims and publishes that do not match it.
reconciler: The second database role: expires leases and reports pending reconciliations, over its own session.
registrar: The staging entry point that hands a validated factory group to the bootstrap registry; performs no I/O.
session: One database connection behind the synchronous facade; owns its runtime; never shared across threads.
stop proof: JSON evidence that the attempt's worker process actually stopped, required by publish and record_stop.
